headword: {出席停止|しゅっせきていし}
gloss: suspension from attending school; mandatory absence

definitions.gloss: suspension from attending school; mandatory absence
definitions.explanation: A school's order that a student must stay home, typically because of an infectious disease (flu, measles, COVID-19) or as a disciplinary measure. Distinct from voluntary sick leave — the student is not allowed to attend.

examples.japanese: ⟦インフルエンザ→インフルエンザ：05384_infuruenza⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{出席停止|しゅっせきていし}になった。
examples.english: I was suspended from school due to the flu.

examples.japanese: {出席停止|しゅっせきていし}⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{欠席|けっせき}→欠席：02495_kesseki⟧⟦{扱|あつか}い→扱い：12777_atsukai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ならない→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The suspension period does not count as an absence.

examples.japanese: {学校保健安全法|がっこうほけんあんぜんほう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{基|もと}づき→基づく：02315_motozuku⟧、⟦{校長|こうちょう}→校長：01582_kouchou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{出席停止|しゅっせきていし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{命|めい}じる→命じる：02309_meijiru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Based on the School Health and Safety Act, the principal can order a suspension from attendance.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{出席|しゅっせき}→出席：02084_shusseki⟧ (attendance) + ⟦{停止|ていし}→停止：04067_teishi⟧ (stoppage). A formal school term — the student is legally barred from attending, most often to prevent the spread of an infectious disease.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {出席停止|しゅっせきていし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to be put on attendance suspension
- {出席停止|しゅっせきていし}⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧: suspension period
- {出席停止|しゅっせきていし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{命|めい}じる→命じる：02309_meijiru⟧: to order suspension from school

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{欠席|けっせき}→欠席：02495_kesseki⟧: absence — general term, may be voluntary
- ⟦{停学|ていがく}→停学：22314_teigaku⟧: suspension — used at the high school/university level, often disciplinary
- ⟦{休校|きゅうこう}→休校：19880_kyuukou⟧: school closure — the whole school closes, not just one student
